profile: BioInsights UI CPU layout, paint and tessellation
limits: CPU measurement only; excludes GPU presentation and end-to-end input latency.
This machine and local dataset only; no universal frame-rate guarantee.
reproduce: Generate an isolated snapshot with OBSERVATORY_PROFILE_DUMP in profile_publication_and_snapshot_clone. Set OBSERVATORY_UI_PROFILE_INPUT to that local file and run cargo test --release --locked -p observatory-desktop profile_bioinsights_paint -- --ignored --nocapture. Optional OBSERVATORY_UI_PROFILE_OUTPUT saves aggregate timings.
